$description: Sutherland acceptance fixtures — per component, the contract a React implementation must satisfy to match the gated reference. Generated from snippet manifests + metas; regenerated each build.

props.name: status
props.$note: Optional RAG status chip in the meta row; meaning carried by the label text, not the dot.

props.name: tag
props.$note: Optional account-type tag (Tags atom).

props.name: sticky
props.$note: Pin the bar to the bottom of a scrolling flow (position:sticky).

props.name: actions
props.$note: 1–3 actions: one primary + optional secondary + optional tertiary (e.g. Back). More than 3 is an anti-pattern.

props.name: size
props.$note: display = 32px, bound to the .t-cm-figure-4 composite (the display/amount token); default = 16px inline body; small = 14px dense rows/tables.

props.name: sign
props.$note: Negative renders a leading U+2212 MINUS in monochrome text — never a colour cue. Positive normally carries no sign.

props.name: redacted
props.$note: Privacy mask: the value is replaced by dots (aria-hidden) and the element carries role=img + an aria-label giving context (e.g. 'Balance hidden').

props.name: size
props.$note: small 36px, medium 44px, large 56px

props.name: size
props.$note: Only on the '.Badge on icon' variant — small 10px, medium 13px, large 20px. The standalone Badge is 12px (simple) / 20px (number).

props.name: state
props.$note: Per .Breadcrumb level. 'no-link' = the current/last item (non-clickable). Hover and Pressed share a single combined state.

props.name: state
props.$note: processing + success seen on primary (rag/success); confirm which states apply to each type.

props.name: size
props.$note: default height 44px; 'Large' variant exists for primary (and likely all types) — confirm Large height.

props.name: state
props.$note: Interactive types only (basic, actions). Non-interactive/image-static types are default-only.

props.name: content
props.$note: Content combinations seen on actions/basic cards.

props.name: title
props.$note: What completed, in plain words (e.g. 'Payment sent') — carries the success meaning, not the icon colour.

props.name: message
props.$note: One-line detail / what happens next.

props.name: actions
props.$note: 1 primary (e.g. Done) + optional ghost (e.g. View receipt).

props.name: style
props.$note: inline = ring + time on one line; stacked = ring with time stacked; undecorated = time value only (no graphic).

props.name: size
props.$note: inline: 210/222/234 wide × 32/44/56 tall; stacked: 88 wide × 82/94/110 tall; undecorated 166×26.

props.name: variant
props.$note: subsection/subsection-inset/section = 1px; break = 4px. subsection-inset is indented by padding/responsive/medium.

props.name: family
props.$note: non-native = custom styled menu; native = OS/browser select control.

props.name: selection
props.$note: filterable + multi-select are non-native only.

props.name: itemSelection
props.$note: list-item level

props.name: itemState
props.$note: list-item level

props.name: text
props.$note: The kicker label; keep it to 1–3 words.

props.name: action
props.$note: Header Content only.

props.name: index
props.$note: Header Section Titles — show a leading index.

props.name: amount
props.$note: Header Section Titles — show an amount/count.

props.name: state
props.$note: Headers Display.

props.name: image
props.$note: Headers Display — with/without an image.

props.name: breakpoint
props.$note: Responsive hero artboards: XL (scale-3), M & L (scale-2), MS (scale-1), S & XS (scale-1).

props.name: asset
props.$note: Background/secondary asset type.

props.name: type
props.$note: Emphasis mirrors Button. Quaternary (ghost) is the most common icon-button in toolbars/inputs; primary icon-only is rare (reserve for a single decisive action e.g. a FAB-like add).

props.name: glyph
props.$note: Icon id from the assets/icons sprite; drives the accessible name unless aria-label overrides.

props.name: label
props.$note: REQUIRED accessible name (aria-label / visually-hidden text). Icon-only = no visible label, so the name is non-optional (4.1.2 / 2.4.4).

props.name: state
props.$note: Date-picker input adds a 'date picker' (open) state. Input label: default/disabled only.

props.name: dateCellState
props.$note: .Date calendar day cell.

props.name: fontSize
props.$note: Arrow link spans font-1…7; Back link font-5/6/7; Icon link S5/S6/S7; Inline link font-5 only.

props.name: state
props.$note: hover and pressed share one combined state (as Breadcrumbs). Disabled only modelled on Icon link.

props.name: multiline
props.$note: Arrow link supports multiline (chevron stays attached to last word).

props.name: state
props.$note: hover labelled 'hover (web)'. Bullets list has no interactive state.

props.name: visual
props.$note: Badge, Item, Transaction offer a leading visual.

props.name: detail
props.$note: List Transaction only.

props.name: bulletType
props.$note: Bullets list only.

props.name: size
props.$note: Web offers all four; iOS & Android offer large/medium/extra-small (no small).

props.name: label
props.$note: Optional caption (e.g. 'Loading') in font-5/6 regular.

props.name: buttons
props.$note: Dialog button layout (single / two side-by-side / stacked).

props.name: breakpoint
props.$note: Video modal is fully responsive (XL scale-3 → XS scale-1); S/XS use a dedicated layout.

props.name: module
props.$note: Partial modal module scale.

props.name: auth
props.$note: Masthead only.

props.name: flyout
props.$note: Masthead flyouts: main nav (closed/scroll/open), search, user.

props.name: breakpoint
props.$note: Masthead/Anchors fully responsive; app nav bars are mobile.

props.name: variant
props.$note: RAG status. Snackbar = warning/success/information only (no error).

props.name: multiLink
props.$note: Contextual 'form multi-link' variant with action links.

props.name: state
props.$note: Page buttons / dropdown trigger states; current page marked active.

props.name: currentStep
props.$note: 1…totalSteps; segments up to the current step use progress/complete, the rest progress/incomplete.

props.name: state
props.$note: App component — no hover state.

props.name: reorder
props.$note: Reorder handle variant (drag to reorder).

props.name: state
props.$note: Drag handle; hover web only. Cursor shows grab → grabbed during drag.

props.name: predictive
props.$note: Predictive-search menu open below the field (single-select list, scrollable).

props.name: label
props.$note: Optional field label + help text + tooltip (Input label).

props.name: checkboxKind
props.$note: Checkbox supports an indeterminate (mixed) state.

props.name: type
props.$note: Single = one handle/value; double = two handles for a range.

props.name: value
props.$note: Track fill position (single shows default/half/full; double shows default/half).

props.name: total
props.$note: Emphasise the final row as a total (heavier weight, larger size).

props.name: items
props.$note: 3–5 destinations. Fewer than 3 isn't a tab bar; more than 5 crowds the targets.

props.name: current
props.$note: The active destination — gets the filled glyph + text/default + aria-current='page'.

props.name: cellAlign
props.$note: Right-aligned for numeric columns.

props.name: track
props.$note: .Tab track elevation=false/true (adds elevation/functional shadow).

props.name: overflow
props.$note: Overflow dropdown (with menu items) when tabs don't fit.

props.name: label
props.$note: Tabs can be label or icon-only.

props.name: type
props.$note: Tag = static label; Tag link = interactive (navigates/filters), has hover/pressed.

props.name: background
props.$note: Background=true draws a filled chip; false is text-only.

props.name: state
props.$note: Tag link only (hover & pressed combined).

props.name: tip
props.$note: Which edge the pointer sits on (tooltip above vs below the trigger).

props.name: tipAlignment
props.$note: Horizontal position of the pointer along that edge.

props.name: variant
props.$note: Standard inline player vs full-width hero player.

props.name: state
props.$note: Playback states (multiple state rows shown on the page).

props.name: type
props.$note: Label segments (text) or icon-only segments.

props.name: state
props.$note: Per-segment; the chosen format is 'selected'.
